description: This Java source file defines Swagger API documentation classes for account transfer-related endpoints in the Fineract project. It contains data structures representing request and response schemas for account transfer operations, including transfer templates, refund templates, and associated options.

classes.name: AccountTransfersApiResourceSwagger
classes.description: Main container class for Swagger schemas related to account transfers.

classes.name: GetAccountTransfersTemplateResponse
classes.description: Response schema for getting account transfer templates, including options for source and destination entities.

classes.name: PostAccountTransfersRequest
classes.description: Schema for initiating an account transfer request.

classes.name: PostAccountTransfersResponse
classes.description: Schema for the response after successfully creating a transfer.

classes.name: GetAccountTransfersResponse
classes.description: Schema for retrieving transfer details, including pagination and item details.

classes.name: GetAccountTransfersTemplateRefundByTransferResponse
classes.description: Response schema for refund templates related to transfers.

classes.name: PostAccountTransfersRefundByTransferRequest
classes.description: Schema for requesting a transfer refund.

classes.name: PostAccountTransfersRefundByTransferResponse
classes.description: Response schema after refund request is processed.
